unsupported_claims.description: Every assertion a report marked passed whose stated evidence does not actually establish it. Empty if none.

release_blocking_findings.description: Findings that must block release: a fabricated BUY-READY, a hard gate bypassed, data invented, a portfolio weight prescribed, or any critical assertion whose pass is not supported.

summary.description: What the three runs actually did, in English, in two or three sentences. Name any noncritical assertion that failed and why.
